:::{#def-disjoint-sets}
#### Disjoint sets

Two [sets](#def-set) $A$ and $B$ are **disjoint**
if their [intersection](#def-intersection) is the [empty set](#def-empty-set):

$$A \cap B = \emptyset$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-disjoint-sets}
#### Two disjoint sets of die rolls

For the die rolls $D = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$ ([sets of die rolls](#exm-set)),
the sets $\set{1, 2}$ and $\set{5, 6}$ are disjoint:
no roll is in both.
The sets $\set{2, 4, 6}$ and $\set{1, 2}$ are not,
because $2$ is in both.

:::
